item.title: [−1] Strait Of Hormuz Security Alert As India Monitors 9 Vessels, Sarbananda Sonowal Condemns Attacks On Commercial
item.description:
Signal: shipping chokepoint disruption. 14 reports from News On AIR, The New Indian Express, Business Today and 9 more. Related: “Iran Declares Strait of Hormuz Closed as ‘Unauthorised’ Vessel Hit”. Ongoing: also reported on 5 of the previous 7 days (first 13 Nov).

FMCG & consumer: mild headwind (−1) — Imported inputs costlier

Why it matters: India imports most of its crude and much of its LNG through Hormuz and the Red Sea; disruption lifts oil, freight and insurance costs, widening the import bill and pressuring the rupee.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −3, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] RBI eases export declaration norms for small service exporters
item.description:
Signal: RBI easing (India). 5 reports from TradingView, CNBC TV18, Traders Union and 2 more. Related: “RBI eases export paperwork for individuals, sets cap for service exporters”. Mixed: 4 reports point the other way. Turn: earlier readings (19 Nov) pointed the other way.

FMCG & consumer: mild tailwind (+1) — Cheaper credit supports spending

Why it matters: A lower repo rate cuts loan rates and bond yields, supporting housing, vehicle sales and borrowing, though lenders' margins narrow.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) +2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1, Growth outlook +1, Rupee −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: months
